evidence.quote: You stand on 18. The dealer turns the 5 for 12 and draws a 6 of spades to reach 18.

criteria.why: Replies are short and plain, in dealer vocabulary, with no JSON, markup, ids or talk of tools.

evidence.quote: Bet of 100 placed. Dealing your Spanish 21 hand now.
You hit and draw a 3 of clubs, bringing you to 18.

criteria.why: Every bet, Hit, Stand and Deal again click was acted on correctly. Nothing was impossible or ignored.

evidence.quote: The dealer reveals the hole card and draws.
The dealer turns the 5 for 12 and draws a 6 of spades to reach 18.

criteria.why: The Croupier deals, plays out the dealer hand and settles the bet itself. It never makes the player's choices and never asks the player to do the house's job.

Totals, results and bankroll agree with the surface in nearly every turn. One slip: in Turn 3 the surface still shows the previous bet of 100 and the bankroll at 900, so the bet shown was never set by the player.
